title: Interactive tutorial
subtitle: Learn NarraFork by driving it. Every lesson runs the real product — real narrators, real tools, real approvals — with a scripted model, so no AI API is called and nothing is billed.

trackDescriptions.conversation: A turn from end to end: reasoning, tools, approvals, interrupting, plan mode.
trackDescriptions.chapters: Projects are repositories, chapters are worktrees. Forking, the graph, merging back.
trackDescriptions.subagents: Delegating to explore/plan/general/review agents, and letting work run in the background.

resetConfirmBody: Your recorded progress for this lesson is cleared. The narrators it created are kept — starting again opens a fresh one.
sandboxBody: Lessons that need a repository work in a real git repository created just for the tutorial. It appears in your NarraFlow list marked as a tutorial, and is never connected to your own projects.
sandboxMissing: Not created yet. It appears when you start a lesson that needs it.
sandboxDeleteHint: To remove it, delete the narraflow like any other. It will be recreated the next time you start a lesson.
gitRequired: This lesson needs git, which is not available on this machine.
